source_reports.citation: Over, T.M., Marti, M.K., O'Shea, P.S., and Sharpe, J.B., 2023, Estimating peak-flow quantiles for selected annual exceedance probabilities in Illinois: Illinois Center for Transportation Series No. 23-019, Research Report No. FHWA-ICT-23-014, 72 p.
Marti, M.K., Over, T.M., and O'Shea, P.S., 2023, Data for estimating peak-flow quantiles for selected annual exceedance probabilities in Illinois: U.S. Geological Survey data release.

notes: Over and others (2023), Illinois Center for Transportation report 23-019, with the USGS data release it points to for everything beyond the 1-percent AEP (Marti and others, 2023, doi 10.5066/P9XPWUMI). Seven hydrologic regions at 8 AEPs. Forms from Table 4; coefficients, n from DR-7 (the report's Table 6 prints only the 1-percent AEP); AVP, MEV and Sp from DR-8; covariance from DR-9, by its row and column labels (DR-9 lists TPI before DEM_Slope, while the equations and this file have DEM_Slope first); ranges from Table 10. Stored as printed, so the covariance keeps its basis: region 1 has log10(TPI) - 3.2259 (scale 10**-3.2259), region 3 has (TPI - 1823.4)/4758.3, regions 3 and 5 have DEM_Slope - 55.329, and region 2 has square roots of the two fractions. Regions 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 are stored twice, as NSS serves them: unadjusted (region_code '1'), and urbanization-adjusted ('1-urban'), which adds (bu)p*(URBTHE2010 - U0) with (bu)p and its standard error from Table 11 (reprinted from Over and others, 2021) and U0 from Table 12. The report's procedure outside region 2 is the adjusted one, so it is preferred, and the unadjusted set is used where URBTHE2010 is missing (region_preference); region= overrides. Region 2's urban term is inside its equation, so it has one set. URBTHE2010's limits of 0 and 1 are those of a fraction: the report prints none. An adjusted equation's covariance is DR-9's matrix with a row and column added, zero but for Var(bu) on the diagonal, which is Figure 23's Vu = Vu0 + Vbu*(U - U0)**2 under its independence assumption; its AVP and SEP are the unadjusted equation's, as in NSS, and do not set its interval. FSSURGDC78 has offset 1e-12 because its printed minimum is 0, six region 2 gages have 0, and the power transform refuses a base of exactly 0; the term moves by at most 1.1e-6 log10 units. NSS's GC2002 has no offset and raises an error at 0. FLC16DVLMH has no offset: its minimum is 0.002045. Every one of the 104 equations agrees with NSS, which folds the centering constants and U0 into its intercept, to 2e-12 log units at the points tested; ranges agree exactly. Worked examples: region 2 gives 1,858 cfs and xUx 0.001831, and region 4 gives 12,989 and 14,885 cfs, xUx 0.001549 and Vu 0.0169 (Figures 14-33). Their intervals differ a little: the report rounds S to two or three figures, and the adjusted equation's URBTHE2010 term is marked fitted: false, so its t keeps the report's n-p. That widens the interval, most in region 7 (t 1.943 rather than 1.895). DR-10 and DR-11 print regression flows and variances at the 422 gages valid for the regressions (unadjusted), and all reproduce from DR-5's characteristics apart from these rounding effects: DR-5 prints drainage area to 2 decimals (0.01 for 0.01327), which explains the largest differences, up to 16 percent. Two small offsets remain, stored as printed because Table 4, DR-7 and NSS agree. Region 1's DR-10 flows lie about 0.36 percent below the printed form, and region 3's about 0.2 percent; a TPI centre of about 3.2246 rather than 3.2259 in region 1, and about 1816 rather than 1823.4 in region 3, removes the offset, and in region 1 also brings the DR-11 variances within rounding. So the tables appear to use slightly different centres than Table 4 prints; the report does not say. Figure 39's near-gage example uses 2,150 cfs where the text says 1,860 and DR-10 prints 2,140 for gage 05527950. The near-gage adjustment and the river-reach interpolation (Figures 36-46) are procedures rather than equations, and are not stored here. Standard errors and t-ratios of coefficients (Table 7, DR-7), RMSE and pseudo R2 (DR-8) have no field and are not stored.
